# iSpring LMS

> A powerful corporate learning management system designed for employee onboarding, compliance training, and enterprise knowledge management with seamless third-party integrations.

iSpring LMS is a comprehensive eLearning platform that serves organizations across industries with tools for content management, course delivery, and learner analytics. The platform supports SCORM standards, integrates with HR and ERP systems via REST API and SOAP, and offers both subscription and lifetime licensing models.

## Key Topics

- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Corporate Training
- Employee Onboarding
- Compliance Training
- SCORM Support
- Course Management
- Knowledge Management
- Third-party Integrations
- GDPR Compliance
- Data Protection
- REST API
- eLearning Platform
- iSpring Suite AI
- Engagement Analytics
- Enterprise Learning
